EnableAlgaePonds.title: Algae Ponds
EnableAlgaePonds.description: Adds pond data so seaweed, green algae and white algae can live in fish ponds.
EnableGenericPonds.title: Generic Ponds
EnableGenericPonds.description: Lets any item without its own pond data go into a pond. It never multiplies and rarely produces anything.
EmptyPondsBecomeAlgae.title: Empty Ponds Grow Algae
EmptyPondsBecomeAlgae.description: Empty ponds turn into a random seaweed or algae pond after some days.
DaysUntilAlgae.title: Days Until Algae
DaysUntilAlgae.description: How many days a pond must stay empty before algae appears.
